title: P03b — Add bounded authored-scene snapshot inputs
description:
## Shared authored-scene snapshot prerequisite
Own stdlib/player/toolchain/specification after P17 and timing prerequisite. Preserve complete ASCII render-pass authored slot capability by referencing a separate authored VideoML scene, not fixed monogram fallback. Define data-only effect parameters sourceSceneId and sourceFrame (composition-absolute nonnegative integer); a static snapshot is captured once at sourceFrame for each mount/preparation, never the changing output frame. Preserve image-asset input as a separate supported mode; scene capture failure is explicit.
Add an optional context sceneSnapshots provider with capture({sceneId,frame,signal}) returning an owned ImageBitmap. Caller owns closing it; late completion after cancellation closes immediately. Renderer bridges through accepted P07 real browser-painted isolated scene capture. Browser preview needs explicit native pixels or injected snapshot provider; absent capability yields SCENE_CAPTURE_UNAVAILABLE. No DOM-to-SVG/foreignObject/html2canvas/SSR substitute. Trusted local TS may provide an adapter; hosted mode accepts only approved declarative references.
Add declarative scene-input metadata to registered effect descriptors so XML preparation can enumerate sourceSceneId/sourceFrame references and validate IDs/frames before opening pages. Build scene dependency graph; reject self-reference and cycles with SCENE_CAPTURE_CYCLE, bound traversal depth8 and at most4 unique snapshots per composition. Bound each snapshot to4096px per dimension,4,194,304pixels and16MiB encoded PNG; aggregate decoded snapshot budget64MiB. Missing provider, malformed reference, oversized pixels and timeout fail explicitly. Use composition dimensions/fps/seed/frozen assets, selected-source visibility override without changing authored scene timing/cues. Capture must settle fonts/assets and honor cancellation, bounded by existing render job deadline and10s individual capture timeout.
Keep snapshots private to a composition preparation keyed by source identity/frame/dimensions/fps/seed/assets identity; no cross-project cache. Dispose pages/bitmaps on failure/cancel/completion, deduplicate identical requests without sharing close ownership. Do not execute visitor-supplied code or allow network assets.
Prove identifiable authored DOM/text/canvas source (not default monogram) at fixed sourceFrame gives exact repeated/reverse output and same copiedXML/packedCLI pixels. Cover nonzero scene start,24/30fps, two source identities, assets/fonts, missing/cyclic refs, bounded decode and cancellation/latebitmap cleanup. Reference compare adapted ASCII pass grid/shimmer/resolve/exit later in C001. No production/network/deployment changes.
Primary orchestration decision: prepare snapshot dependency DAG topologically, dependencies first at their declared fixed sourceFrame. Capture each requested source in an isolated P07 browser page with its dependencies already injected; keep at most one snapshot capture page live during preparation, closing it after retaining bounded PNG bytes. Transfer PNG through the trusted local bridge, never ImageBitmap across Playwright pages. Decode a separately owned bitmap in each consuming page. Cache keys distinguish the same scene at different frames, while cycle detection remains scene-reference based. Budget includes in-flight transfer/decode and all live copies:64MiB total retained/in-flight encoded PNG and64MiB total decoded bitmap bytes. Reject before allocations that exceed either. The10s request deadline includes queue, capture, transfer and decode, and remains bounded by whole-job deadline. Cancellation closes active page and late bitmaps, clears retained bytes; dependencies are released after no remaining consumer and all pages close on terminal completion. No unmanaged recursive capture launches. Test diamond dependencies, distinct frames of same scene, nested snapshots, cancellation at each phase and duplicate bitmap close ownership.
Primary API correction before publication: sceneSnapshots.capture returns OwnedSceneSnapshot {bitmap: ImageBitmap, close():void}. Consumer owns handle and calls idempotentclose, not rawbitmap.close; provider accounting decrements exactlyonce and disposal closes outstandinghandles, latecompletion closesimmediately. Do not monkeypatchnativeImageBitmap.close. Duplicate pending capture subscribers require independent deadlines/cancellation; individualabort doesn'tcancelanotherconsumer, compositionabortcancelsall. Add repeatedacquire/close beyondbudgetcycles, doubleclose, decode-dispose race and abortedduplicate tests. Extend portable trustedTS metadata as canonicalP03bdecision: composition.customEffects declarative scene-input map boundbydigest, browsermatchesmetadata, hostedrejectunchanged.
